title: Pullback, tensor product and direct images on $\Dctf$ at all coefficient stages
statement:
Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\Zl,\mathcal O_E,\Ql,E,\Qlb\}$ be admissible and let
$f:X\to Y$ be a separated morphism of finite type of the standing schemes.

1. $f^*$ maps $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, and
   $\otimes^{\mathbf L}_\Lambda$ maps $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)\times\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$
   into $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$.
2. For a locally closed immersion $a$ (in particular a quasi-compact open
   immersion), $a_!$ preserves $\Dctf$.
3. $Rf_*$ and $Rf_!$ map $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$.
4. $f^!$ maps $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: The standing scheme hypotheses give qcqs spaces. Apply the exact pullback constructibility and Tor-amplitude lemmas of unboundedLocalizingPullback to obtain the first clause.

Apply lem-sfb-admissible-tensor-constructibility for the bounded-constructibility component. Choose Tor intervals [a,b] and [c,d] from the two hypotheses and apply generic torAmplitudeIn_tensor to get [a+c,b+d]. Unfold only derivedTensor and curriedTensor to identify the stated tensor.

For the specified locally closed factorization a = j followed by i, form its compactification with open j and proper i. The finite-type hypotheses give quasi-compactness of j and the boundary compactification. The Dctf clause of compactification_localizing applies to exactly the displayed composite D(j_!) followed by R(i_*).
Apply lem-sfb-admissible-direct-image to f and K for the ordinary direct-image clause.
Give the specified chosen compactification its quasi-compact open-leg instance, regard it as a boundary compactification, and apply the Dctf clause of compactification_localizing.

Apply exceptionalInverseImage_exists to the bundled morphism over Spec k. It supplies a right adjoint Gprime with the required Dctf preservation. Any right adjoint G in the statement is naturally isomorphic to Gprime by rightAdjointUniq. The inclusion of the full localizing subcategory carries this isomorphism to the ambient derived category. Transport the bounded-constructible and finite-Tor properties using their isomorphism-closure clauses.
